notes.title: The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase Has Begun!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Do you love kicking your cerebral cortex into overdrive? Do you long for those 'aha!' moments when you finally solve a pesky puzzle? Well, look no further than the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/078fabc87a8c2bd13ec3a7d51b6204bede9cbd8b.png

There's a bunch of sales, demos, and streams to check out, and as the newest puzzle kid on the block, we wanted to make sure we're a part of it! We highly recommend you check out the event page.

What is Recursive Ruin?
And if you came here from the event page, welcome! Recursive Ruin is a kaleidoscopic puzzle game where you'll need to make your way through seemingly impossible, infinitely repeating worlds.

https://media.giphy.com/media/98gCf6T15MpgOy385F/giphy.gif

It's not all brain-melting puzzles, though. You'll explore a touching story about dealing with grief and finding meaning in life, in part through your feline friend Behemoth, The Cat.

https://media.giphy.com/media/YdTwD8587j41AUUhXt/giphy.gif

Sounds good, right? You can pick up Recursive Ruin at 10% off during our launch week! You can also check out the demo to get a taste of the recursive goodness we have to offer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561890/Recursive_Ruin/

notes.title: Recursive Ruin — OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's happening!

It is our distinct pleasure to announce that Recursive Ruin is now available! We still can't quite believe the game is out, but it is! Wow! If you're new here and want to learn more, check out the trailer below.

[previewyoutube=nY0vs-_gw6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Manipulate an infinitely recursive landscape to solve a series of environmental puzzles as you work through your own struggles with grief and a creative crisis.

With Behemoth, The Cat at your side — or at least somewhere nearby — unlock an introspective journey through your past and discover new meaning in a chaotic world.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xdgymcXESOkkUENTKF/giphy.gif

Lose yourself in the Infinite Realms, a dying, fractal world of strange beauty and mind-bending physics that repeats eternally inward and outward. Uncover the secrets of seven hypnotizing landscapes filled with hidden spaces and bizarre celestial denizens. Overcome the impossible and use circular logic to manipulate recursive physics and solve challenging self-referential puzzles.

https://media.giphy.com/media/98gCf6T15MpgOy385F/giphy.gif

Begin an introspective search for meaning and experience a bittersweet story that cascades into the surreal. Use your unique abilities and shape the world to beat back the scourge known as Ichor, a malevolent substance eating away at the fabric of reality.

https://media.giphy.com/media/67AvLlcX2cl4Js7E8F/giphy.gif

Through the fight against the Ichor, and the satisfying completion of peculiar puzzles, balance out the chaos of the Infinite Realms and reconcile your own inner turmoil.

https://media.giphy.com/media/YdTwD8587j41AUUhXt/giphy.gif

You can pick up Recursive Ruin for $14.99 (USD) / £12.99 / €13.99 with a 10% discount during its launch week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561890/Recursive_Ruin/

And if you're in need of some tunes, we've got you covered. You can also pick up the Recursive Ruin Official Soundtrack, consisting of 18 trippy, brain-melting tracks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961290/Recursive_Ruin_Soundtrack/

"You could, of course, quit any time you like. But where's the fun in that?"

---

If this seems like your cup of infinitely repeating tea, then consider picking up Recursive Ruin today! Let us know what you think on the Steam forums, or on Discord.

notes.title: Recursive Ruin — Coming May 18th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are beyond excited to announce that Recursive Ruin is releasing on May 18th! In just over a week's time, you can experience all the mind-bending puzzles and touching story moments that Recursive Ruin has to offer. Check out the brand new trailer and get a taste for the full release.

[previewyoutube=J43FcvrKInE;full][/previewyoutube]

If that trailer left you with more questions than answers — mission accomplished. New here, or need a quick refresher on Recursive Ruin? We've got you covered.


A beautiful, infinitely repeating world consisting of seven hypnotic landscapes.
Mind-bending puzzles that require out-of-the-box thinking to solve.
A hauntingly beautiful soundtrack to go with the trippy aesthetics.
A touching story about grief, meaning, and hope.
Behemoth, The Cat.  

A Beautiful, Dying World
Lose yourself in the Infinite Realms, a dying, fractal world of strange beauty and mind-bending physics that repeats eternally inward and outward. To progress, you'll have to think outside of the box as you shift the world, turning walls into passageways as the world collapses and expands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/43b1ca4f4de75666a9b10fe6158f7e4c54f0b058.gif

Accompanying the beautiful and weird visuals, is an equally trippy and brain-melting soundtrack. Just listen to the trailer above to get a sense of the OST's vibe.

A Deeply Personal Journey
It's not just puzzles. Begin an introspective search for meaning and experience a bittersweet story that cascades into the surreal. Use your unique abilities and shape the world to beat back the scourge known as Ichor, a malevolent substance eating away at the fabric of reality.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/45615415c84d1e7349676da2d928a192e04e46ca.gif

Behemoth, The Cat
Enough said.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/5c0c03166efe6e733d4b3b5c9c5df375c775923e.gif

If Recursive Ruin sounds like it's up your strange alley, make sure you wishlist the game! You can also check out the demo until May 18th, so if you want to give it a try, now's the time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561890/Recursive_Ruin/

notes.title: Recursive Ruin - Behind The Scenes!
notes.content:
Hi folks! 

After finally getting to announce Recursive Ruin about a month ago, we wanted to give you all a bit of a look behind the scenes of the game.

But first, a question. Do you like sales? Of course you do. We'd like to point you in the direction of the Iceberg Interactive Publisher Sale, where you can get up to 90% off on Iceberg Interactive titles for the coming week! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/716e7990339faeb270f5a9e487a4f9c8fc4b89cc.png

Now, without further ado, let's get into Recursive Ruin.

[previewyoutube=5fXshHxyOiM;full][/previewyoutube]

Music
Music is incredibly important to us. In fact, both of us have PhDs in Music Informatics (an interdisciplinary field between computer science and music). We especially love weird music, which translates into the soundtrack of Recursive Ruin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/021e7117c273832f8a173ddd140f4c45f602dcc5.jpg

A look under the hood of how it all starts. We usually start by scribbling things on paper, then experimenting. And yes, "Piano thing" is an industry term. Trust us, we're doctors. If you haven't yet, listen to the music in our trailer to get a feel for the vibe we're going for.

Síoraíocht
A quick introduction to an important character in Recursive Ruin: Síoraócht. Síoraócht (affectionately nicknamed Bismuth Head by us) is the deity of the Infinite Realms. That black goo you see drooping from her head? Yeah, that's not good.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/ff052228b8d9353382c8404a300daba0aeffe156.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/00f8b98d3c8cdd5293acd0e181742c34e8aa4dbc.jpg

We can't go into much detail about Síoraócht without getting into spoiler territory, so we'll leave it at this for now. 

Hopefully you enjoyed a quick little look under the hood! We may drop some more nuggets in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/82613840e165385270bb8a71e2bf9693a37e51de.png

notes.title: An Introduction To Recursive Ruin
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to finally share our game, Recursive Ruin, with the world! 

Recursive Ruin is a kaleidoscopic first-person puzzle adventure game. That might not mean much to you, so here’s another way of phrasing it: Recursive Ruin is a puzzle game in which the world is constantly on loop, repeating itself infinitely. 

[previewyoutube=OZGMT0RBsG0;full][/previewyoutube]

You play as a despondent artist in search for meaning, sitting alone in his dark apartment, finding an escape through video games. You’ll embark on a bittersweet journey that cascades into the surreal.

Features


 Beautiful, unique, infinitely fractal worlds to discover
 Challenging, mind-bending puzzles that require circular logic to solve
 A bittersweet story about life and the search for meaning
 A hauntingly beautiful, trippy soundtrack


Sounds good, right? Together with Iceberg Interactive, we’ll be bringing Recursive Ruin to you in 2022!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561890/Recursive_Ruin/

If you have any questions, feel free to ask them on Discord!
